g.text: Precondition: staff member is logged in.
Trigger: enter or change their own availability.
staffId comes from the authenticated user.
Each selectable day or night shift lasts 12 hours.
The form is restricted to the five-week planning period.
Exact cut-off time is a supplied policy value.
[submittedAt is after this week's Wednesday cut-off]
[submittedAt is on or before this week's Wednesday cut-off]
lateWeeks contains only the weeks flagged late.
Both on-time and late submissions are saved.
The saved availability, including affected late flags,
is now available to managers for roster planning.
[one or more submitted roster weeks are late]
Postconditions: own submitted availability and late flags are stored;
managers can see the saved availability; an audit record exists.
Any late submission or change has been notified to the manager.
Published assignments are unchanged. Any subsequent amendment
requires an authorised manager through UC-06 Amend Published Roster.
UML 2.5. Boundaries, controllers and operations are proposed detailed design (I08).
Database requests describe persistence; no SQL schema is assumed.
I01: late-branch persistence is explicit to satisfy the source postconditions.
